title: Ensuring Proper P-Trap Slip-Joint Sealing
description: P-traps use a standing water seal to block sewer gases from escaping into living spaces. During fixture installation, misaligned slip-joint connections strain bevel washers, leading to persistent slow leaks and potential joint failure. To achieve a durable, watertight connection, align the sink tailpiece and trap arm perfectly straight before tightening the nut. Always tighten plastic slip nuts firmly by hand first, adding no more than a quarter-turn with pliers if necessary. Over-tightening warps the bevel washer and creates leak paths.

Ensuring Proper P-Trap Slip-Joint Sealing

P-traps use a standing water seal to block sewer gases from escaping into living spaces. During fixture installation, misaligned slip-joint connections strain bevel washers, leading to persistent slow leaks and potential joint failure. To achieve a durable, watertight connection, align the sink tailpiece and trap arm perfectly straight before tightening the nut. Always tighten plastic slip nuts firmly by hand first, adding no more than a quarter-turn with pliers if necessary. Over-tightening warps the bevel washer and creates leak paths.
